title: game of life
how: 180×180 binary matrix seeded 12% at random; each step a 3×3 neighbour-count convolution decides who lives: born on 3, survives on 2 or 3.

title: rule 90
how: 270-cell binary vector seeded at random; each generation is the xor of every cell's two neighbours (rule 90), stacked over time into a scrolling matrix.

title: rule 110
how: 270-cell binary vector seeded at random; each generation runs every 3-cell neighbourhood through an 8-entry lookup table, 01101110 (rule 110), stacked over time.

title: mandelbrot
how: 720×720 grid of complex numbers c; iterate z = z² + c and colour every point by its normalised escape count, re-sampled each frame as the view zooms in.
